workload.inputType: fixed geometric FP32 depth and normal maps
workload.timingScope: Fusion process including input load and PLY/VIS output, native GNU time; preparation and map generation excluded
workload.order: One excluded FP32 warmup then all eight modes followed by reverse order at each resolution
workload.hardwareCounterScope: Same timing pass, user-only cycles/instructions/cache events; software counters cover process activity; all recorded events100%running

quality.units: Unchanged native reconstruction units; degrees; RGB8 levels
quality.note: Approximate normals are not bitwise output parity. Geometry/attribute maxima and visibility changes include rare differences; same-mode parallel repeats are included as context. No laser accuracy, meshing or rendered-image quality claim.

cacheDiagnostics.note: Decoded admission charge and mapped address-space charge are not physicalRSS. Per-callobservations kept.

tradeoffs: Octahedral direction uses4bytes instead of12and discards original normal magnitude.
SNORM tiles use6bytes instead of12and require finite components in[-1,1].
Decision guards protect normal acceptance decisions; accumulated decoded normals remain approximate.
Resident guard requires one preloader; FP32 and plain-oct one-preloader controls are separate from default-preload results.
Tile modes share1GiBdecoded-admission and512MiBmapped-address-space budgets. Mapping charge is not physicalRSS.
Guarded resident mode incurs large systemCPU/contextswitch cost on these Windows-backed inputs; nativeext4 latency has not been measured here.
N2 is a bounded characterization; timing ranges, both observations and hardware running fractions are retained.
